meaning: The total provider-call envelope for the whole 2026-11-07 delivery program (docs/DELIVERY_PLAN_2026-11-07.md), read by the budget gate (TC-015, src/repo_presenter/core/llm/budget.py) before any non-replay provider call. Zero-call activity classes (recertification, obligations/rule checks, probes, the example verifier, ledgers, funnel, census, item-level restore where proved zero-call) are never charged against this envelope and need no entry here to proceed. A call outside an open batch, or past either cap, raises instead of calling the provider -- see docs/DELIVERY_PLAN_2026-11-07.md section 7 for the inference-class table this derives from. Only the owner raises total_calls_cap or total_tokens_cap, or changes batch_size, per_batch_cap_multiplier or stop_rule_multiplier; the supervisor opens and records batches within them.
note: Batch 001 opened 2026-11-09 by the supervisor, per R25/R11 ("the supervisor opens and records batches within them"), to make M8's FIRST real, live provider calls through TC-023b's prose_judge_live.py wiring -- a small, deliberately conservative cap (30 calls / 50k tokens, well under the per_batch_cap_multiplier bound since there is no prior measured median yet) to prove the pipeline end-to-end and get a first real cost reading before sizing any larger calibration batch. Credentials (GPT_OSS_ENDPOINT/GPT_OSS_API_KEY) were confirmed present by name only (never read) before opening this batch.
